title: SG-6 · Clean up leftover references to removed code
summary: Remove the last references to worker, execution and coding-agent code, and document the handoff to devion workseed
description: Context: the worker, execution backend, config keys, routes and ExecutionPanel are already deleted. Two leftovers remain. game/frontend/src/components/LifecycleStepper.tsx still exports deriveStage and an EXECUTION_STAGES map that only served the removed execution flow, and nothing in src imports deriveStage. The docs say nothing about the handoff: backend/README.md contains only 'hello Worldseed', there is no docs/ folder, and nothing describes the frozen-contribution export. Desired behavior: no code or docs refer to execution state, and the docs describe the handoff to devion workseed. Expected result: backend and frontend tests pass with game/src, the game UI, game/content, backend/internal/contribution and the round lifecycle unchanged. Why: Worldseed is a game and contribution project, not a development platform.
acceptance_criteria: Given LifecycleStepper.tsx, when it is read, then it has no deriveStage export and no execution-status mapping, and AdminApp still renders LifecycleStepper from round.status
Given the backend README and the handoff doc, when they are read, then they describe the handoff of frozen contributions to devion workseed using the Export JSON format
Given the backend and game/frontend unit test suites, when they run, then they pass

preserve: Existing guard tests for removed code

technical_constraints: Go backend module and Vitest frontend must stay green
Do not modify game/src, game/content or backend/internal/contribution non-test code
definition_of_done: Both requirements are implemented and verified by unit tests
No execution references remain in LifecycleStepper or docs
